name: @clarvis/protocol
description: DRAFT — the transport-agnostic contract between a Clarvis kernel (loop as a server) and its UI clients. Wire DTOs + the KernelClient interface. Carries NO dependency on @clarvis/loop, so a UI (e.g. @clarvis/code) depends only on this and never imports the engine.
author: getclarvis

scripts.clean: bun -e "await Bun.file('dist').exists() && await import('node:fs/promises').then(({rm}) => rm('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}))"
